The design is fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).

Bugs fixed in `rtl/debouncer.v`:
1. The counter wasn't cleared when `din == dout`, so stale glitch counts could persist across agreement cycles.
2. The toggle threshold was `cnt == N` instead of `cnt == N - 1`, causing `dout` to flip one cycle later than the spec's "N-th consecutive edge" requirement.
